observations: Photo 0 shows a light green and cream-colored sewing machine with the brand 'brother' visible on the front panel.
The model number '911' is visible next to the brand name on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine has a large orange knob on the right side, a metal needle and presser foot assembly, and a bobbin case area.
There is visible wear and chipped paint on the body, especially on the front and side panels.
Photo 1 shows the left side of the machine, revealing a white motor attached to the base with a belt connecting to the main shaft.
The motor has a label, but the text is not legible in the photo.
The machine appears to be placed on a tiled floor, and there are watermarks from 'Jiji' and 'BOLA BABATIMEHIN' overlaid on both images.
No power cord is visible in either photo.
